findings.citation: spec.md ## Problem, confirmed phone mockup ('Edited · computed £25.00' left in the details); story 10
findings.note: Same cause as F1, seen in the mobile goldens: the edited note sits flush right under the amount; the Fee 'Other' row splits its details across both sides. Fix: max-xl:text-left on LINE_AREA.edited.

At 1440 the BILLED header, the amounts, the buttons and the note sit on three different right edges (fixed 128px actions slot); right-align the header over the amount track or align the note to the amount.
A row with two badges or a collision cuts the name hard ('Birch T…', 'Solstic…'); full name only in title (hover). Matches the spec; flagged to the human walkthrough.
The auto-focused amount field is 12px (text-label-sm); iOS Safari zooms a focused input under 16px, forcing a pan. Fleet controls share it; max-xl:text-base on correction fields, or debt.

At 390 the ghost sm buttons' px-3 puts the labels ~12px in from the amount's right edge (ragged right column), and self-end sits them ~6px below the 'Logged' line; -mr-3 on the actions group and centring on the last details line.

findings.citation: spec.md Solution: "Nothing on the page scrolls sideways"; story 6 (amount and Edit on one line in the Billed column); Solution Width: "The 720px minimum comes back at `xl`, where the invoice area is at least 736px wide."
findings.note: At exactly 1280x800 the line-table wrapper is 692px wide against the 720px minimum, so it scrolls sideways and clips the Billed header, the 'Edited · computed' notes and the editor's Cancel (evidence/step-5-overflow-1280-vs-1440.txt). The spec's 736px premise is false at 1280. Orchestrator's decision (a how): drop the 720px minimum at xl for these two tables too, so they fit their wrapper at every width; record it as an (after review) decision; check 1280 and 1366.
